limitations: Only deterministic, centered zero-minimum SPD quadratic objectives in exact arithmetic; does not address positive loss floors, stochastic gradients, preconditioning, nonquadratic models or trajectory convergence. The classic scaled-Polyak condition-number barrier and the optimal fixed-step worst-case factor are known prior facts, not claimed novel. Historical equivalence remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Exact analytic one-step result for centered SPD quadratics. Formulae verified by reconstruction and a standalone checker; no claim of independent peer review or external validation.
title: Two sharp regularization transitions for nonnegative Gauss–Newton steps on SPD quadratics
